RPA | Power Apps & Automation Solutions
Experienced IT professional with 10+ years in software engineering, specializing in Robotic Process Automation (RPA) with 6+ years of hands-on implementation on Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, AI Builder, Copilot Studio, Blue Prism and UiPath Proven expertise in team leadership, solution design, and process automation across diverse industries. Skilled in DevOps practices (Ansible Ops), cloud integration (Dell Boomi), and observability solutions (Grafana, Kibana). Adept at designing scalable automation frameworks, conducting feasibility assessments, and delivering high-quality solutions under tight deadlines.
